Hi Luke / Megan — quick replies to your two questions and a final checklist so AP has everything they need to create invoices once PO is issued.

Answers:
- Consolidated monthly invoice: yes, AP can accept a consolidated monthly invoice for the pilot. Please include the PO number on every invoice line and itemize as: Pilot – Hosted Inference (units/tokens) or Pilot – Dedicated Capacity (hours), whichever matches the SKU on the PO. We can support CSV line-level detail if you prefer.
- Signed MSA: For pilot activations we are flexible. DPA + PO will allow us to invoice for the pilot; if you expect to expand we recommend the MSA be countersigned before a production-scale commit. Laura, feel free to chime in if legal needs a different approach.

Next steps checklist for Stellara (final):
1) Complete DocuSign DPA (link: https://docusign.com/embedded?token=abc123-stellara-dpa) — confirm in reply
2) Submit PO to ap@redwoodinference.com with PO number, billing contact, and remit address above
3) Return completed stellara_subprocessor_inventory.csv (or confirm you accept our inventory)
4) If you need full SOC 2, reply to this thread and Laura will send NDA + secure report link
5) Optional: Book a 20-min sync with Ben to map invoice format to your ERP — Ben, could you propose times?
